facts.content: Patient presents with breathing difficulties after a wasp sting 15 minutes ago.
facts.source_text: CC: Breathing difficulties after wasp sting 15 minutes ago

facts.content: Patient was stung by a wasp while gardening.
facts.source_text: HPI: Stung by a wasp while gardening;

facts.content: Since the wasp sting the patient has noticed shallow breathing.
Since the wasp sting the patient has experienced chest tightness.
facts.source_text: now noticing shallow breath, chest tightness

facts.content: Since the wasp sting the patient has experienced lip tingling.
facts.source_text: now noticing shallow breath, chest tightness, lip tingling;

facts.content: Patient has a history of eczema.
Patient is on no current medications.
Penicillin allergy is documented in the objective findings.
Breathing is shallow with chest tightness.
Lip and tongue have tingling sensation.
No throat swelling is observed or reported.
There is blotching urticaria on the body.
Assessment is an acute allergic reaction to a wasp sting with airway and breathing involvement and possible anaphylaxis risk requiring urgent emergency department evaluation.
facts.source_text: 1) Acute allergic reaction to wasp sting with airway/breathing involvement; possible anaphylaxis risk; requires urgent ED evaluation

facts.content: An ambulance is to be called immediately and the spouse is to arrange transport to the emergency department.
facts.source_text: Ambulance to be called now; spouse to arrange transport to ED

facts.content: Patient is to take a home antihistamine, administer it now if available, and bring it to the emergency department.
facts.source_text: Take and bring home antihistamine to ED; administer now if available

facts.content: Patient is to monitor for progression of symptoms, go to the hospital promptly, and escalate care if symptoms worsen.
facts.source_text: Monitor for progression; go to hospital promptly; escalate if symptoms worsen
